title: Newton driver unit tests
objective: Write unit tests for newton_solve(): 1-element convergence in 1 iteration, divergence detection, Dirichlet DOF enforcement, history commit/rollback.
implementation_steps: Test (a): 1-element linear elastic converges in 1 iteration — use ref_hex8_elastic assembly functions as callbacks
Test (b): divergence detection — mock a divergent system, verify converged=False returned
Test (c): Dirichlet DOFs remain zero — verify u[bc_mask] == 0.0 after solve
Test (e): history commit/rollback — verify commit called on success, rollback on failure
acceptance_criteria: Linear elastic system converges in exactly 1 Newton iteration
Constrained DOFs are exactly zero after solve
verification_commands: uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/ -m 'not slow and not gpu' -x -q
